description: The ONE retrieval contract for UHS knowledge. Every caller — fleet CLI, dashboard, skills and interactive agents — resolves collections, layer order, authorization scope and dedupe from THIS file. Collection selection is data, not code, so the CLI and the dashboard cannot drift apart again. Byte-identical copies are vendored in uhsJARVIS at scripts/agent-os/knowledge/retrieval-policy.json; a drift test in each repo fails if they diverge.

layers.description: Capability/vendor/project registry lookup. Answers 'do we have X?' with a path, never from memory.
Structured authoritative business data (Supabase uhsMLS/uhs-jarvis, Assessor). Current facts come from records, not prose.
Scoped source documents and wiki: deterministic lookup over registered document roots.
Semantic retrieval over the federated permitted collections. Always cited, never authoritative on its own.

org.name: uhs
org.description: JARVIS business knowledge base: vault/, USER.md, AGENTS.md, SOUL.md. The collection the dashboard could reach and the CLI could not.

org.name: shared-{org}
org.description: CortexOS org-shared collection. '{org}' is substituted with the caller's org, so this entry works for every org while the literal entries above are UHS-specific and are simply absent (and reported as such) elsewhere.

operator.description: Scott, or an authenticated dashboard session acting as him.

agent.description: A fleet agent or persona. Sees org knowledge and its own private collection only.

service.description: An unattended script, skill or cron with no persona identity.

authorization.restricted_note: Persona-private, HR, personal and financial-instrument scope. scope='all' means 'all I am permitted to see', never 'every collection on disk'.

federation.note: The requested scope is intersected with the caller's role grants. A scope can never widen a grant.

ranking.note: Layer order is AUTHORITY, not display order. A weak registry keyword match must not bury a strong semantic hit, so results rank by score band first and layer order only inside a band. Each layer also has a min_score: a deterministic keyword layer that barely matched contributes nothing.

dedupe.note: Two collections holding the same document collapse to one citation; the highest-scoring, highest-authority copy wins and the duplicates are recorded on the citation.

rules: A failed input is NEVER archived or moved as a success.
Idempotence is by stable source id (canonical absolute path) plus content hash.
'indexed' is a claim; only 'retrieval_verified' is evidence.
Failed inputs stay in the retryable inbox with their classified error until they succeed or a human retires them.

freshness.note: Source newer than its index entry is lag; two indexed sources disagreeing on the same claim is a conflict. Both are surfaced, never silently resolved.

structured_sources.lookup: ILIKE on address → parcel_id, sqft, beds, baths, year_built, subdivision, zip, lat/lon
ILIKE on agent_name → license_number, phone, email, office_name, in_crm
APN dash-stripped; enumerate layers before assuming which carries owner name. Owner is NOT the listing agent.
Client lookup uses Supabase project and contact records. GoHighLevel is RETIRED (2026-07-06) and must never be queried.

retired_sources.note: Any retrieved guidance naming GoHighLevel as the CRM is obsolete. Answer from the successor and say the old guidance is retired.
calendly.com links are dead; UHS self-hosts its scheduler.

registry_sources.description: Org-wide capability registry: skills, scripts, repos, scheduled jobs, fleet agents, MCPs and vendor accounts by env-key name. A vendor hit means WE ALREADY HAVE IT.
